brawlers.name: Vince
brawlers.description: Vince tends to both the espresso machine and his many-legged friends, much to his customers' dismay. He walks slowly around his Creepy Café, careful not to step on any of his beloved bugs. His companions, Mocha and Doppio, follow him everywhere.

gadgets.name: Hot Coffee
gadgets.description: Vince throws an explosive cappuccino, dealing area damage.

gadgets.name: Metamothosis
gadgets.description: Vince turns all nearby caterpillars into moths, gaining an additional moth for each collected.

starPowers.name: Come To Papa
starPowers.description: Nearby caterpillars crawl towards Vince.

starPowers.name: Bug Bandage
starPowers.description: Turning a caterpillar into a moth heals Vince for x.

brawlers.name: Cosmo
brawlers.description: Cosmo is the lead astronomer at Starr Park's Observatory. Besides teaching visitors about the universe, he is constantly gazing at the stars searching for something...

gadgets.name: Planetary Pushback
gadgets.description: Cosmo knocks enemies back from the targeted area.

gadgets.name: Telescope Trap
gadgets.description: Cosmo uses his telescope to reveal an area for xs sec, including invisible enemies. Enemy Brawlers inside this area cannot use movement abilities (dashes, jumps, teleports, etc.).

starPowers.name: Precession
starPowers.description: Increases the orbit speed of Cosmo's main attack by x%.

starPowers.name: Ammo Attractor
starPowers.description: Hitting an enemy with Cosmo's Super reloads 2 ammo.

brawlers.name: Wendy
brawlers.description: A smart scientist, with a nostalgic soul. After years working in shady corporate laboratories, she left to build Windstock and help the planet, not harm it!

gadgets.name: Wind-Powered
gadgets.description: Wendy's platform gives her a boost and she jumps a short distance.

gadgets.name: Green Grenade
gadgets.description: Wendy launches a wind grenade that slows all enemies hit and stops them healing momentarily.

starPowers.name: Slowing Shield
starPowers.description: Enemies in Wendy's shield generator are slowed.

starPowers.name: Solar Shield
starPowers.description: Wendy's shield generator gains an additional x health.

brawlers.name: Nori
brawlers.description: As the child of Kenji and Kaze, Nori was always destined for great things. Being the first Brawler ever born in Starr Park has also given him extraordinary powers! He's not too bad at cooking either.

gadgets.name: Sushi Snack
gadgets.description: Nori eats up to x fish to heal himself for x per fish.

gadgets.name: Gonna Need A Bigger Net
gadgets.description: Aim a fishing net that roots the first Brawler hit for x sec and deals x damage.

starPowers.name: Big Haul
starPowers.description: Nori catches 3 fish when his Super hits enemy Brawlers.

starPowers.name: His Mothers Son
starPowers.description: Nori gains +20% speed for 1 sec whenever he hits an enemy with his Main Attack.

brawlers.name: Bolt
brawlers.description: Bolt is a toy from the Battle Bumperz line, designed to deal damage by rolling into things! He was built to battle, but always wanted to be a race car, so he reaches dangerous speeds to live out his dreams. Don't get in his way!

gadgets.name: Oil Change
gadgets.description: Bolt gains a x - x health shield based on his current speed.

gadgets.name: Bouncy Ball
gadgets.description: Bolt jumps to a target location and deals area damage. Breaks environments but loses all speed when landing.

starPowers.name: Toss Up
starPowers.description: Bolt will knock enemies upwards when he's at full speed.

starPowers.name: Unstoppaball
starPowers.description: Bolt is immune to crowd control for 1 seconds after activating his Super.

brawlers.name: Starr Nova
brawlers.description: A cosplayer who believes they are the anime character Starr Nova! This can get a bit awkward, as she believes problems in the real world can *also* be solved by hitting them with a massive sword.

gadgets.name: Floaty Time
gadgets.description: Starr Nova deploys an anti-gravity device, allowing teammates to float inside of the area!

gadgets.name: Shining Starr Of Friendship And Justice
gadgets.description: Starr Nova fires an energy ball that damages enemies and heals teammates for x. This energy ball can also be teleported to before it hits a target!

starPowers.name: Power Level Maximum
starPowers.description: Hitting an enemy Brawler while transformed increases your damage by 4% to a maximum of x%.

starPowers.name: Mystical Starr Technique
starPowers.description: Starr Nova's main attack also heals teammates for x, charging her Super based on healing.

brawlers.name: Damian
brawlers.description: Damian LOVES to make noise. He fronts a band with his brother, Draco, but music puts him into an uncontrollable rage, where he destroys anything in sight! His shows usually end with him smashing everything near the stage… including other Brawlers.

gadgets.name: Spiritual Healing
gadgets.description: Damian throws his microphone to a target location. The first teammate to pick it up is healed for x health.

gadgets.name: Wall Of Sound
gadgets.description: Damian summons a temporary wall of indestructible amps!

starPowers.name: Crowdkill
starPowers.description: Knocking a target into a wall stuns them for 0.5 sec.

starPowers.name: Vulgar Display Of Punch
starPowers.description: Damian has a flaming fist during his Super, which burns enemies.

brawlers.name: Najia
brawlers.description: Hired by Finx to make Pyramid Quest's puzzles harder, her good nature actually led her to help those trapped by his time-warping mischief instead.

gadgets.name: Poison Puddles
gadgets.description: All enemies currently poisoned by Najia will create poisonous puddles for the next x sec.

gadgets.name: Najia Jar
gadgets.description: Najia hides inside a vase. Once the vase is broken, she will knock back any nearby enemies!

starPowers.name: Poisonous Protector
starPowers.description: Brawlers defeated while poisoned by Najia will spawn a snake in their place.

starPowers.name: Venomous
starPowers.description: Poison damage scales with the target Brawler's current percent health, dealing up to an extra x damage when a target is at 100% health.

brawlers.name: Sirius
brawlers.description: His identity is as mysterious as his powers. He had the very first attraction at Starr Park, but rumor has it he was kicked out unfairly, and banned from ever returning. Now... he's back for REVENGE.

gadgets.name: A Starr Is Born
gadgets.description: Sirius fires a projectile that summons a Shadow on hit, also slowing the hit target by x% for x sec.

gadgets.name: Master Of Shadows
gadgets.description: Summoned Shadows return to Sirius, who heals them for 25% of their health.

starPowers.name: Dusk Runners
starPowers.description: Shadows have +15% movement speed.

starPowers.name: The Darkest Starr
starPowers.description: Each hit with a Shadow Strike counts as 2 to collect Brawler Shadows, instead of 1.

brawlers.name: Glowy
brawlers.description: A marine biologist working at the Starr Park aquarium, Glowy is obsessed with sea life, wanting to introduce it to as many visitors as he can. Although he might seem a bit creepy, he's actually a nice guy! Maybe.

gadgets.name: Slippery Savior
gadgets.description: Glowy dashes in a target direction, healing himself and teammates for x on arrival.

gadgets.name: More Lumens
gadgets.description: Glowy supercharges his glowbeam tethers, doubling the damage/healing rate for x secs.

starPowers.name: Biotic Ecosystem
starPowers.description: If Glowy is tethered to an enemy and a teammate at the same time, it will reduce the enemy damage by x% and increase the teammate's damage by x%.

starPowers.name: Parasitism
starPowers.description: Tethering to an enemy also heals Glowy for x% of the damage dealt.

brawlers.name: Gigi
brawlers.description: A cursed puppet who brings an unsettling vibe, Gigi and her bonded magician's glove are never found apart. You can find her in the Oddities Shop, dancing between the bookshelves.

gadgets.name: Longer Strings
gadgets.description: Super charging area is bigger.

gadgets.name: Disappearing Act
gadgets.description: Gigi creates an area that makes herself and allies invisible while inside. Lasts x secs.

starPowers.name: Plie Protection
starPowers.description: Increases Super charge rate by x% if no damage has been received for x secs

starPowers.name: A Helping Hand
starPowers.description: SHADOW PUPPET now heals for x after charging up.

brawlers.name: Pierce
brawlers.description: You know pool lifeguards? Pierce is one of those. Except he shoots people instead of saving them. OK maybe he isn't like a lifeguard at all. When Buzz decides there has been too much pee in the pool, he calls in Pierce to 'clean up'.

gadgets.name: Bottomless Mags
gadgets.description: Reload x ammo and drop a shell next to Pierce.

gadgets.name: You Only Brawl Twice
gadgets.description: Pierce will absorb all shells and gain x shield for each one, while also pushing back nearby enemies.

starPowers.name: Mission Swimpossible
starPowers.description: Pierce's last ammo also slows enemies by x%.

starPowers.name: Slip N Snipe
starPowers.description: When collecting a shell, Pierce gains a short burst (15%) of movement speed.

brawlers.name: Ziggy
brawlers.description: Ziggy is an uber theatrical magician who excels at using electricity in his act. He's a bit full of himself, but hey, he can literally control lightning. Just remember... they're not tricks, they're illusions.

gadgets.name: Electric Shuffle
gadgets.description: Ziggy hits the nearest enemy with lightning strikes every second for x sec. These attacks cost no ammo.

gadgets.name: Now You See Me...
gadgets.description: The next lightning strike also teleports Ziggy to the same location.

starPowers.name: Thunderstruck
starPowers.description: Brawlers damaged by Ziggy's Super are slowed by x% for x sec.

starPowers.name: The Great Ziggini
starPowers.description: Hitting with a lightning strike increases the damage of the next main attack by x%.

brawlers.name: Mina
brawlers.description: Mina is a b-girl who mixes capoeira into her breakdance battles like it's second nature. She hangs out at SK8 Beats with Ollie and uses his mixtapes to practice new moves!

gadgets.name: Windmill
gadgets.description: Creates a wall of wind that blocks projectiles for x sec.

gadgets.name: Capo-What?
gadgets.description: Mina's next Super recharges instantly if it hits.

starPowers.name: Zum Zum Zum
starPowers.description: Mina's combo Attack 3 also heals for x% of damage done.

starPowers.name: Blown Away
starPowers.description: Mina's Super also roots enemies on the spot.

brawlers.name: Trunk
brawlers.description: Trunk is a suspiciously uncanny-looking tree. It couldn't be because Trunk is actually a colony of hyper-intelligent ants controlling a fake mechanical tree? No, that would be ridiculous.

gadgets.name: For The Queen
gadgets.description: Trunk instantly spreads ants in a large area.

gadgets.name: Worker Ants
gadgets.description: Trunk heals from the first source of damage taken for the next x secs.

starPowers.name: New Insect Overlords
starPowers.description: Ants also reduce the damage of enemies by x%

starPowers.name: Colony Scouts
starPowers.description: Ants reveal hidden enemies.

brawlers.name: Alli
brawlers.description: Alli is the shy mechanic of the Love Swamp. She loves to get her hands dirty, by either fixing broken machines or... mercilessly stalking other Brawlers. If you're walking home late at night and hear an odd noise, it's probably Alli trying to say hello.

gadgets.name: Feed The Gators
gadgets.description: The next main attack heals Alli for x% of damage dealt.

gadgets.name: Cold-Blooded
gadgets.description: Alli becomes enraged for the next x secs. Can only be activated when an enemy is visible.

starPowers.name: Lizard Limbs
starPowers.description: While enraged Alli regenerates health faster out of combat after only x seconds.

starPowers.name: You Better Run You Better Take Cover
starPowers.description: Alli reloads x% faster while enraged.

brawlers.name: Kaze
brawlers.description: Kaze was raised to be a living weapon by her parents, but this was not the life she wanted. After escaping to Starr Park with Kenji, she can now live how she wants. However, she is still torn between the two aspects of her life, being a humble geisha and a deadly ninja.

gadgets.name: Gracious Host
gadgets.description: Switch to Ninja Aspect and gain x% Movement Speed for x sec

gadgets.name: Hensojutsu
gadgets.description: Switch to Ninja Aspect and gain short invisibility

starPowers.name: Advanced Techniques
starPowers.description: Hitting an enemy in a Strike Spot also slows them by x% for x sec

starPowers.name: Gratuity Included
starPowers.description: Removes x% ammo from Brawlers initially caught in the Fan Storm

brawlers.name: Jae-Yong
brawlers.description: By day, Jae-yong is your average office worker. By night, he is a karaoke GOD... or so he thinks. The jury is still out on his singing skills.

gadgets.name: Weekend Warrior
gadgets.description: Deals area damage and increases main attack damage for x sec.

gadgets.name: Time For A Slow Song
gadgets.description: Jae-yong slows enemies around him and his attacks will leave trails of slowing paperwork for x sec.

starPowers.name: The Crowd Goes Mild
starPowers.description: Being near teammates gives Jae-yong a 15% speed boost per teammate in range.

starPowers.name: Extra High Note
starPowers.description: Main Attacks now deal an additional x% Damage per target pierced.

brawlers.name: Finx
brawlers.description: The owner of Starr Park's escape room, Finx is meant to help visitors complete tasks. Instead, he uses his time controlling abilities to cause mischief! Also, he LOVES cats.

gadgets.name: Back To The Finxture
gadgets.description: Finx steps back in time, returning to the position and ammo he had x seconds ago.

gadgets.name: No Escape
gadgets.description: Finx's next projectiles from his main attack freeze the enemies in time for x seconds, making them unable to take actions for the duration, but also making them immune to any damage.

starPowers.name: Hieroglyph Halt
starPowers.description: Finx reduces the reload speed of any enemy Brawlers hit by his main attack by 25% for 3 seconds.

starPowers.name: Primer
starPowers.description: Damage dealt only from Finx's projectiles that are sped up by Time Warp, will increase the Super duration by x seconds each.

brawlers.name: Lumi
brawlers.description: A passionate metalhead and a talented drummer, Lumi traded her drumsticks for morning stars when she got her job at Starr Park. She controls elements of ice and fire, which reflects her shy nature and her burning passion for music!

gadgets.name: Hit The Lights
gadgets.description: Lumi ignites her morning stars on the ground, producing flames which damage nearby enemies for x seconds. Damage per second: x

gadgets.name: Grim And Frostbitten
gadgets.description: Lumi creates freezing winds around her morning stars on the ground, creating a slippery surface for x secs.

starPowers.name: 42% Burnt
starPowers.description: The explosions from Lumi's Blast Beat also set the area alight for x seconds. Fire damage also scales with explosion damage. Damage per second for the biggest explosion: x

starPowers.name: Half-Time
starPowers.description: Lumi slows enemies hit by her recalled morning stars for x seconds.

brawlers.name: Ollie
brawlers.description: Ollie rides his customized hoverboard around Starr Park, grinding rails and causing trouble! A fan of old school hip hop, Ollie blasts his favorite tunes wherever he goes. His music is infectious... literally. Brawlers can't help but dance when they hear it.

gadgets.name: Regulate
gadgets.description: Ollie jumps and does a rad kickflip, hypnotizing all enemies where he lands for x seconds.

gadgets.name: All Eyez On Me
gadgets.description: Ollie's next attack will hypnotize any enemies hit for x seconds.

starPowers.name: Kick Push
starPowers.description: While near walls, Ollie kicks off his hoverboard and gains 20% extra movement speed.

starPowers.name: Renegade
starPowers.description: After dashing forward with his Super, Ollie gains a 3000 decaying shield over 4 seconds.

brawlers.name: Meeple
brawlers.description: Meeple knows the rules to every board game in existence and if you break them... Well let's just say you don't want to break them. They hate cheaters and those who break the rules. There's only one exception... Meeple themselves!

gadgets.name: Mansions Of Meeple
gadgets.description: Meeple's next attack creates dice towers around the impact area and deals x damage.

gadgets.name: Ragequit
gadgets.description: Meeple lashes out in rage at nearby enemies, stunning and knocking them back. The less hitpoints Meeple has, the stun and knockback effects increase.

starPowers.name: Do Not Pass Go
starPowers.description: When you shoot through environment deal x more damage.

starPowers.name: Rule Bending
starPowers.description: Critical success also increases allies reload speed within the area by x%.

brawlers.name: Buzz Lightyear
brawlers.description: Buzz Lightyear has arrived in Starr Park! Starting his journey with an accidental delivery to the Gift Shop, Buzz has since been impressing Brawlers with his three different Brawling modes!

gadgets.name: Turbo Boosters
gadgets.description: Buzz Lightyear activates his turbo, sprinting forward in his current direction.

starPowers.name: Laser Mode
starPowers.description: Buzz Lightyear's laser has extended range, allowing him to hit targets from farther away.

starPowers.name: Saber Mode
starPowers.description: Buzz Lightyear charges his Super by absorbing damage taken and benefits from increased health.

starPowers.name: Wing Mode
starPowers.description: Buzz deploys his wings, gaining a boost in movement speed.

brawlers.name: Juju
brawlers.description: Juju owns the Oddities Shop and is followed everywhere by her "pet" voodoo doll, Gris-Gris (pronounced Gregory). Although she can control the elements, Juju is also a talented toymaker who makes dolls to sell to Starr Park's many visitors.

gadgets.name: Voodoo Chile
gadgets.description: Juju's next main attack has the power of all three elements.

gadgets.name: Elementalist
gadgets.description: Juju gains a temporary buff based on the current environment she is standing on. Earth: Damage reduction Grass: Invisibility Water: Increased movement speed

starPowers.name: Guarded Gris-Gris
starPowers.description: Gris-Gris is summoned with a protective shield.

starPowers.name: Numbing Needles
starPowers.description: Gris-Gris' attack now also slows the enemy for x sec

brawlers.name: Shade
brawlers.description: Not much is known about this mysterious pile of clothes, other than the fact it has some cool sunglasses. Discovered by Gus, Shade was given a name and now the two spooky Brawlers haunt the Ghost Station together.

gadgets.name: Longarms
gadgets.description: The next main attack has 50% longer range.

gadgets.name: Jump Scare
gadgets.description: Shade jumps a short distance, fearing enemies for x sec when landing.

starPowers.name: Spooky Speedster
starPowers.description: Hitting opponents with the center of Shade's main attack gives a short movement speed boost.

starPowers.name: Hardened Hoodie
starPowers.description: Shade gets 30% damage reduction while in its Incorporeal Form.

brawlers.name: Kenji
brawlers.description: This highly skilled sushi chef has a wholesome life running his restaurant in Starr Park, but it feels like he's trying to hide something about his past... though his sushi tastes so good, nobody cares!

gadgets.name: Dashi Dash
gadgets.description: Kenji's basic attack only uses Dash for the next x seconds.

gadgets.name: Hosomaki Healing
gadgets.description: Kenji instantly heals x% of damage taken over the last x seconds.

starPowers.name: Studied The Blade
starPowers.description: Slashimi's slices have x% longer range

starPowers.name: Nigiri Nemesis
starPowers.description: After avoiding damage for x seconds, gets x% damage reduction from the next enemy attack.

brawlers.name: Moe
brawlers.description: Moe is a blind rat, found living in the Starr Park sewers by Grom, who then quickly adopted him! Now part of Starr Park's maintenance team, Moe uses his special digging machine, Driller, to traverse the sewer tunnels... and also cause a bit of destruction throughout the park, much to Ash's dismay.

gadgets.name: Dodgy Digging
gadgets.description: Moe digs up some "borrowed" goods, increasing his Super charge rate by x% for x seconds.

gadgets.name: Rat Race
gadgets.description: Moe dashes a short distance in his Driller, destroying walls and knocking back Brawlers in the process.

starPowers.name: Skipping Stones
starPowers.description: Moe's basic attacks bounce one more time. The range of the attack remains the same.

starPowers.name: Speeding Ticket
starPowers.description: Moe's Driller has 25% increased travel speed.

brawlers.name: Clancy
brawlers.description: There's no turning back with Clancy (unless Hank orders him to). He's fully embraced his fake crustacean life and will do anything for his comrades.

gadgets.name: Snappy Shooting
gadgets.description: Clancy gains double tokens for x seconds.

gadgets.name: Tactical Retreat
gadgets.description: Clancy dashes and reloads x ammo

starPowers.name: Recon
starPowers.description: Clancy starts the match with x tokens.

starPowers.name: Pumping Up
starPowers.description: Clancy reloads all of his ammo on every enemy takedown.

brawlers.name: Berry
brawlers.description: Working at Mandy's Candy Shop, what could go wrong? EVERYTHING! Luckily, Berry has the patience and toughness of a workhorse. He seems to hate every second of his job, but at the end of his shift, you might catch a brief smile.

gadgets.name: Friendship Is Great
gadgets.description: Berry swipes his tail, knocking back enemies and healing nearby allies for x health.

gadgets.name: Healthy Additives
gadgets.description: Berry's next main attack area lasts for x% longer.

starPowers.name: Floor Is Fine
starPowers.description: Berry gains x% increased reload speed when standing on his own melted ice cream.

starPowers.name: Making A Mess
starPowers.description: Berry's basic attack gains x% extra damage on impact in areas with no ice cream.

brawlers.name: Lily
brawlers.description: A nerd at heart and a total witchcraft buff, Lily's thirst for knowledge once led her into the Enchanted Woods, where an incident involving a firefly and a carnivorous plant would change her life forever...

gadgets.name: Vanish
gadgets.description: Lily enters the Shadow Realm for x seconds

gadgets.name: Repot
gadgets.description: The next Flourish, becomes a thrown attack, and Lily teleports to the destination on impact

starPowers.name: Spiky
starPowers.description: After teleporting to an enemy, Lily's next attack deals x more damage

starPowers.name: Vigilance
starPowers.description: Gain 15% movement speed while an enemy is in her Super charge radius.

brawlers.name: Draco
brawlers.description: Riding his inflatable dragon and setting off fireworks, Draco promises a show-stopping finale every night. With his electric guitar blaring and his flame-spewing ride rocking the crowd, he turns the fantasy up to eleven!

gadgets.name: Upper Cut
gadgets.description: The next Lance Stab also throws enemies in the air for a short time.

gadgets.name: Last Stand
gadgets.description: Draco can not fall under one health for x seconds.

starPowers.name: Expose
starPowers.description: Every x seconds, the next Lance Stab exposes enemies on hit. Exposed enemies take x% increased damage for x seconds.

starPowers.name: Shredding
starPowers.description: Dragon Solo now also heals for x when activated.

brawlers.name: Angelo
brawlers.description: Angelo is the Love Swamp's resident cupid-turned-mosquito. They buzz around the canals looking for lovebirds to dazzle with their irresistible charm, even if those require a little extra, pointy incentive.

gadgets.name: Stinging Flight
gadgets.description: Fly into the air for x seconds. Drains x health from nearby enemies on takeoff.

gadgets.name: Master Fletcher
gadgets.description: The next Take Aim pierces enemies and the environment.

starPowers.name: Empower
starPowers.description: Staying inside the Super will heal Angelo for x per second.

starPowers.name: Flow
starPowers.description: Angelo gains 25% increased movement speed after entering water.

brawlers.name: Melodie
brawlers.description: When it comes to Karaoke, Melodie shows no mercy. Armed with her kawaii looks and devilish set of pipes, she never fails to steal the limelight.

gadgets.name: Perfect Pitch
gadgets.description: Melodie's notes get x% increased movement speed and x% wider orbit for x seconds.

gadgets.name: Interlude
gadgets.description: Melodie gains x% Shield from each note orbiting her.

starPowers.name: Fast Beats
starPowers.description: Melodie gains 6% increased movement speed from each note orbiting her.

starPowers.name: Extended Mix
starPowers.description: Melodie's notes last for x% longer before vanishing.

brawlers.name: Larry & Lawrie
brawlers.description: Larry sells tickets to Starr Park visitors under the watchful eye of his twin, Lawrie. Larry loves rules, they make life easier! Lawrie doesn't love rules so much as enforcing them. They make a good team.

gadgets.name: Order Swap
gadgets.description: Swap weapons with Lawrie.

gadgets.name: Order Fall Back
gadgets.description: Dash towards Lawrie while Lawrie dashes towards you, healing both for x% of max health.

starPowers.name: Protocol Protect
starPowers.description: While Lawrie is in range, transfer x% incoming damage to himself instead.

starPowers.name: Protocol Assist
starPowers.description: While Lawrie is in range, reload x% of your ammo whenever he damages an enemy.

brawlers.name: Kit
brawlers.description: Stuck giving autographs to his rabid fans at Starr Toon Studios, cartoony superstar Kit often daydreams of becoming relevant in the industry again, respected for his acting chops rather than his looks.

gadgets.name: Cardboard Box
gadgets.description: Hide in a cardboard box becoming invisible for x seconds. Charges the Super x faster while stationary.

gadgets.name: Cheeseburger
gadgets.description: Heals himself and the friendly Brawler he is attached to for x.

starPowers.name: Power Hungry
starPowers.description: Kit gains x% power from each Power Cube.

starPowers.name: Overly Attached
starPowers.description: Kit attaches to friendly Brawlers for x seconds longer.

brawlers.name: Mico
brawlers.description: Mico's the sound guy in Brawlywood, but one could be forgiven for thinking he's actually a celebrity given all the bragging and name-dropping. Hot-tempered and unstable, he cannot take a joke. Don't ever call him funny...

gadgets.name: Clipping Scream
gadgets.description: Mico lets out a deafening scream towards the nearest enemy, dealing x damage and slowing down enemies for x seconds on hit.

gadgets.name: Presto
gadgets.description: Mico's next jump has x% longer range.

starPowers.name: Monkey Business
starPowers.description: Every x seconds, Mico's basic attack steals ammo from his enemies after hitting them.

starPowers.name: Record Smash
starPowers.description: Mico deals x% extra damage against non Brawlers.

brawlers.name: Charlie
brawlers.description: Itsy bitsy Charlie Put on a crazy show She let down her hair And made off with all your dough In came the crowd It filled up the circus tent So Charlie weaved away while Taking every cent!

gadgets.name: Spiders
gadgets.description: Charlie releases x spiders that seek and attack the nearest enemies.

gadgets.name: Personal Space
gadgets.description: Charlie cocoons herself, healing x% of her total health.

starPowers.name: Digestive
starPowers.description: Cocooned enemies lose x% of their health while cocooned.

starPowers.name: Slimy
starPowers.description: Cocoon leaves a slimy trail behind it for x seconds that slows down enemies walking over it.

brawlers.name: Chuck
brawlers.description: Once a brilliant maestro, now a train conductor, Chuck traded the symphonies of the concert halls for the cacophonies of the Ghost Station, all in the hope of discovering the next big thing in music!

gadgets.name: Rerouting
gadgets.description: Chuck removes the nearest Post and charges 50% of his Super.

gadgets.name: Ghost Train
gadgets.description: Chuck's Supers can go through walls for 8 seconds!

starPowers.name: Pit Stop
starPowers.description: Placing a Pole slows x% any hit enemy for x sec.

starPowers.name: Tickets Please
starPowers.description: Dashing through enemies with his Super will also steal x% of their ammo.

brawlers.name: Pearl
brawlers.description: Against all odds, Pearl found her way into Belle and Sam's hardened hearts thanks to her disarmingly warm nature. Besides, who can resist chocolate cookies?

gadgets.name: Overcooked
gadgets.description: Next basic attack shoots burning cookies, dealing x extra damage over time.

gadgets.name: Made With Love
gadgets.description: Next basic attack shoots perfectly baked cookies ignoring enemies and healing allies for x over time instead.

starPowers.name: Heat Retention
starPowers.description: Super will consume x% less Heat when used.

starPowers.name: Heat Shield
starPowers.description: While the Heat is over x%, reduce damage taken by x%.

brawlers.name: Doug
brawlers.description: Doug's hot dogs will extend your friends' shelf life.

gadgets.name: Double Sausage
gadgets.description: The next Snack Attack only heals allies but doubles the amount.

gadgets.name: Extra Mustard
gadgets.description: The next Snack Attack only damages enemies but doubles the amount.

starPowers.name: Fast Food
starPowers.description: When Doug revives an ally successfully, he will heal for x% of his max health.

starPowers.name: Self Service
starPowers.description: Snack Attack also heals Doug by x.

brawlers.name: Cordelius
brawlers.description: Gardener and caretaker of the Enchanted Forest. Obsesses over mushrooms and is hostile towards strangers.

gadgets.name: Replanting
gadgets.description: Cordelius jumps over a piece of terrain quickly.

gadgets.name: Poison Mushroom
gadgets.description: Cordelius's next main attack shoots a poison mushroom that prevents the enemy from attacking for x seconds.

starPowers.name: Comboshrooms
starPowers.description: Hitting the second mushroom to the same target as the first, deals x% extra damage.

starPowers.name: Mushroom Kingdom
starPowers.description: Cordelius spawns x mushrooms to the Shadow Realm after using his Super, healing allies and damaging enemies for x health on pickup.

brawlers.name: Hank
brawlers.description: Hank is a one-shrimp, one-tank army on a mission to liberate sea life from kitchens and markets everywhere. Chefs, consider yourselves on notice!

gadgets.name: Water Balloons
gadgets.description: The next Balloon Blast also slows down enemies for x seconds.

gadgets.name: Barricade
gadgets.description: Hank takes x% reduced damage for x seconds.

starPowers.name: Its Gonna Blow
starPowers.description: When Balloon Blast is charged over 80%, Hank gains 10% extra movement speed.

starPowers.name: Take Cover
starPowers.description: Hank takes x% less damage when near a wall.

brawlers.name: Maisie
brawlers.description: Maisie works as a safety coordinator, but deep down she enjoys dangerous situations. Sometimes, it almost feels like she has a hand in creating them.

gadgets.name: Disengage
gadgets.description: Maisie blasts the ground, stunning enemies for x seconds while dashing forward.

gadgets.name: Finish Them
gadgets.description: Maisie instantly reloads x ammo and increases the next Pressure Rocket damage by x% of the target's missing HP.

starPowers.name: Pinpoint Precision
starPowers.description: Pressure rocket deals x% more damage at max distance.

starPowers.name: Tremors
starPowers.description: Enemies hit by Shockwave are also slowed down for x seconds.

brawlers.name: Willow
brawlers.description: Willow works as a gondoliera in the Swamp of Love. She gives couples in search of a romantic evening the creepiest, most unsettling time they could imagine.

gadgets.name: Spellbound
gadgets.description: Willow's next Lantern's Curse deals x more damage and applies the entire damage instantly rather than over time.

gadgets.name: Dive
gadgets.description: Willow dives for x seconds, becoming untargetable but unable to take any action for the duration.

starPowers.name: Love Is Blind
starPowers.description: Lantern's Curse also reduces reload speed of affected Brawlers by 30% for 3 seconds.

starPowers.name: Obsession
starPowers.description: Hexed enemies gain 33% movement speed while mind controlled.

brawlers.name: R-T
brawlers.description: R-T is designed to be a helpful information kiosk, but he's also been given the task of monitoring all activity within Starr Park. For safety reasons, of course.

gadgets.name: Out Of Line
gadgets.description: Instantly charges R-T's Super.

gadgets.name: Hacks
gadgets.description: Instantly trigger all active marks on all enemy Brawlers, dealing their damage.

starPowers.name: Quick Maths
starPowers.description: Marks created last x seconds longer.

starPowers.name: Recording
starPowers.description: R-T and his legs take x% less damage when split.

brawlers.name: Mandy
brawlers.description: Mandy runs a candy store where she dresses in costume and doles out sweet treats. She's a little too into the act and rules her candy kingdom with an iron fist.

gadgets.name: Caramelize
gadgets.description: Mandy's next candy from her Candy Dispenser slows down enemies on hit for 2.5 seconds.

gadgets.name: Cookie Crumbs
gadgets.description: Mandy's next candy from her Candy Dispenser pierces enemies and environment.

starPowers.name: In My Sights
starPowers.description: Mandy shoots her candies with x% more speed while Focused.

starPowers.name: Hard Candy
starPowers.description: Mandy receives x% shield while Focused.

brawlers.name: Gray
brawlers.description: Gray styles himself as a character in an old silent film. He takes the act seriously but sometimes forgets to keep his mouth shut when doing finger bullets.

gadgets.name: Walking Cane
gadgets.description: Gray's next hit from the Finger Pistol shoots a walking cane which pulls enemies back by a bit.

gadgets.name: Grand Piano
gadgets.description: Gray's next hit from the Finger Pistol will also leave a target on the ground where a piano will land and hurt enemies. It would be too bad if someone would get hurt, right?

starPowers.name: Fake Injury
starPowers.description: When Gray has full health, the next damage taken is reduced by x%.

starPowers.name: New Perspective
starPowers.description: When Gray or his Allies use Doors, they recover x% of their max hit points.

brawlers.name: Chester
brawlers.description: Chester makes vicious fun of anyone in sight, trying to get under their skin. The more hate he gets, the better... especially if that hater is Mandy!

gadgets.name: Spicy Dice
gadgets.description: Chester gets a new random Super that is different from his current one.

gadgets.name: Candy Beans
gadgets.description: Chester eats a mystery flavored candy bean from his cap, gaining a random buff for x seconds.

starPowers.name: Single Bellomania
starPowers.description: The first bell of Chester's attack sequence does x% damage.

starPowers.name: Sneak Peek
starPowers.description: Chester will always know what his next Super will be.

brawlers.name: Buster
brawlers.description: Buster took a film projector from the movie theater where he works so he can play around with it like a prop. It's dangerous and highly unprofessional!

gadgets.name: Utility Belt
gadgets.description: Buster heals himself and all nearby allies for x health for each ally in his Super's charge area.

gadgets.name: Slo-Mo Replay
gadgets.description: Buster's next Lens Flare pulls enemies towards him.

starPowers.name: Blockbuster
starPowers.description: Buster's Lens Flare deals x% more damage for each ally in his Super's charge area.

starPowers.name: Kevlar Vest
starPowers.description: While Montage is active Buster takes x% less damage and is immune to knockbacks, slows and stuns.

brawlers.name: Gus
brawlers.description: Gus looks so much like a ghost child that he's often mistaken for one. Perhaps fittingly, he's an enthusiast of all things Supernatural, since he's too innocent to be scared.

gadgets.name: Kooky Popper
gadgets.description: Explode all uncollected spirits, dealing x damage to nearby enemies.

gadgets.name: Knockback Spirit
gadgets.description: Gus throws a spirit, knocking back enemies and dealing x damage.

starPowers.name: Health Bonanza
starPowers.description: Healing gained from spirits is increased by x%.

starPowers.name: Spirit Animal
starPowers.description: Spooky increases the damage of a teammate by x% for x seconds.

brawlers.name: Sam
brawlers.description: A former factory worker turned wanted member of the Goldarm Gang, Sam is always there to ensure Belle doesn't go too far on their latest heist!

gadgets.name: Magnetic Field
gadgets.description: While the Knuckle Busters are on the ground, Sam can activate them to pull in nearby enemies.

gadgets.name: Pulse Repellent
gadgets.description: Upon landing on the ground, Sam's next deployed Knuckle Busters releases an electric pulse that knocks back enemies.

starPowers.name: Hearty Recovery
starPowers.description: Upon recalling his Knuckle Busters, Sam instantly recovers x% of his missing health.

starPowers.name: Remote Recharge
starPowers.description: While the Knuckle Busters are on the ground and near enemies, they will charge up Sam's Super.

brawlers.name: Otis
brawlers.description: Otis is a young street artist on the come-up who works by shooting ink at the walls. Nobody knows his true identity, which only adds to his mystique!

gadgets.name: Dormant Star
gadgets.description: The next starfish will stay on the ground if an enemy is not hit, laying dormant until an enemy gets close.

gadgets.name: Phat Splatter
gadgets.description: Otis's next attack shoots a giant ink ball that leaves a puddle, dealing x damage over time for x seconds.

starPowers.name: Stencil Glue
starPowers.description: Cil mightily squeezes the enemy with all his might. Preventing them from attacking for x% longer.

starPowers.name: Ink Refills
starPowers.description: Otis now shoots x% more ink drops.

brawlers.name: Bonnie
brawlers.description: Bonnie is a bundle of uncontrollable and totally destructive energy. Her dream is to be fired from her cannon, all the way to the moon!

gadgets.name: Sugar Rush
gadgets.description: Clyde's movement and reload speed are increased by 30% for 5 seconds.

gadgets.name: Crash Test
gadgets.description: Bonnie dashes forward, knocking back enemies and dealing x damage on hit.

starPowers.name: Black Powder
starPowers.description: The range of Bonnie's Star Launcher is increased by x%.

starPowers.name: Wisdom Tooth
starPowers.description: Loose Tooth shatters on hit, dealing x% extra damage to nearby enemies.

brawlers.name: Janet
brawlers.description: Janet will do whatever it takes to reach the top! As a bonus, her performing skills come in handy for rescuing her sister Bonnie, whenever she gets into trouble.

gadgets.name: Drop The Bass
gadgets.description: Janet deploys a speaker that deals x damage per second to all enemies in the area until it gets destroyed.

gadgets.name: Backstage Pass
gadgets.description: Janet's next High Note pushes her back, even over walls. The more focused her attack is, the further she'll be pushed back.

starPowers.name: Stage View
starPowers.description: While in the air with her jetpack, Janet reveals a large area of bushes around herself.

starPowers.name: Vocal Warm Up
starPowers.description: Janet's attack focuses x% faster.

brawlers.name: Eve
brawlers.description: Eve's purpose in life is to mother and protect her precious babies! She'll do whatever it takes to find them a good home... preferably in Ruffs' fur

gadgets.name: Gotta Go
gadgets.description: Eve jumps away and leaves behind a hatchling.

gadgets.name: Motherly Love
gadgets.description: Hatchlings spawned from an active big egg will now heal allies over time instead of dealing damage.

starPowers.name: Unnatural Order
starPowers.description: Reverses the order of the eggs shot by her Egg Shooter.

starPowers.name: Happy Surprise
starPowers.description: Every x seconds, the next largest egg hitting an enemy of her Egg Shooter will spawn a hatchling.

brawlers.name: Fang
brawlers.description: Fang has absorbed so many kung-fu movies he practically lives in one. He's confident, charming, and never uses his hands if he can kick instead!

gadgets.name: Corn-Fu
gadgets.description: Fang tosses a handful of corn kernels into the air, making it rain popcorn! Each kernel pop deals x damage.

gadgets.name: Roundhouse Kick
gadgets.description: Fang spins and hits all enemies around him, stunning them for x seconds.

starPowers.name: Fresh Kicks
starPowers.description: When Fang defeats an enemy Brawler with his Super, it's recharged instantly, allowing him to use his Super again!

starPowers.name: Divine Soles
starPowers.description: Reduce x damage from incoming hits once every x seconds. Maximum reduction is x% of the incoming damage.

brawlers.name: Lola
brawlers.description: Lola makes sure everyone knows when she enters a room. She's an expert in the fine art of causing a scene to get what she wants, and she's proud of it!

gadgets.name: Freeze Frame
gadgets.description: Lola's Ego stops moving to strike a pose! Gaining a x% shield for x seconds.

gadgets.name: Stunt Double
gadgets.description: Lola and her Ego switch locations, both recovering x health.

starPowers.name: Improvise
starPowers.description: When down to her last round, Lola deals an extra x% damage.

starPowers.name: Sealed With A Kiss
starPowers.description: Projectiles from Lola's Ego will heal allies that are caught in its path by x health.

brawlers.name: Meg
brawlers.description: Content to work behind the scenes with her trusty mecha suit, Meg takes care of real problems, while Max and Surge are out entertaining the crowds.

gadgets.name: Jolting Volts
gadgets.description: Heal the Mecha by x health per second for x seconds. Can only be used in mecha form.

gadgets.name: Repurpose
gadgets.description: Meg ejects from the Mecha, launching it forward, dealing x damage on the way. Charges Super after during the next x seconds.

starPowers.name: Force Field
starPowers.description: Meg is protected by a x% shield for x seconds when her Mecha is destroyed.

starPowers.name: Heavy Metal
starPowers.description: The Mecha recovers x health for each enemy hit with Feel the Steel (Super in Mech).

buffies.name: Jolting Volts Buffie
buffies.description: Jolting Volts heals for +1 sec.

buffies.name: Force Field Buffie
buffies.description: Meg gains +20% movement speed while the shield is active.

buffies.name: Heavy Metal Buffie
buffies.description: Feel the Steel also steals 1 Ammo from enemy Brawlers.

buffies.name: Hypercharge Buffie
buffies.description: The Mecha's Main Attack explodes, dealing 360 area damage.

brawlers.name: Ash
brawlers.description: Ash has the thankless job of keeping the park clean. He's climbed into a trash can to protect himself from broken glass and rat bites. It makes him grumpy!

gadgets.name: Chill Pill
gadgets.description: Though furious, Ash has to collect himself. A full Rage meter will recover x health when this Gadget is popped - less Rage, less recovery.

gadgets.name: Rotten Banana
gadgets.description: Ash loses x% health and instantly gains x% rage.

starPowers.name: First Bash
starPowers.description: When hitting an opponent with his attack charges full, Ash gets even more angry. His Rage goes up by x%.

starPowers.name: Mad As Heck
starPowers.description: Ash progressively gains up to x% faster reload speed, equal to how enraged he's become.

brawlers.name: Griff
brawlers.description: Griff acts like a rich, successful entrepreneur, but his only business is the failing Starr Park Gift Shop. Oddly, he's never around when the bank calls.

gadgets.name: Piggy Bank
gadgets.description: Griff throws a firecracker-filled piggy bank that explodes after a short delay, destroying obstacles and dealing x damage to opponents within range.

gadgets.name: Coin Shower
gadgets.description: Griff throws a shower of coins at target area, dealing x damage per sec to opponents inside.

starPowers.name: Keep The Change
starPowers.description: Griff gains a slightly wider attack and adds another row of coins to the coin toss.

starPowers.name: Business Resilience
starPowers.description: Every 2 seconds, Griff regains up to 15% of his missing health.

buffies.name: Piggy Bank Buffie
buffies.description: Griff can shoot the piggy bank to charge up and increase its explosion radius and damage! The piggy bank will explode instantly when it's fully charged.

buffies.name: Coin Shower Buffie
buffies.description: The coin shower grows in size throughout its duration.

buffies.name: Keep The Change Buffie
buffies.description: Attacking with full ammo also fires a mega coin that deals extra damage! Business Resilience 54% pick Every 2 seconds, Griff regains up to 15% of his missing health.

buffies.name: Business Resilience Buffie
buffies.description: When Griff's Super projectiles return, they heal Griff for 5% of his missing health.

buffies.name: Hypercharge Buffie
buffies.description: Griff's main attack also pierces enemies.

brawlers.name: Buzz
brawlers.description: Buzz is a lifeguard at the Velocirapids water park and a real stickler for the rules. He clearly enjoys wielding the tiny bit of authority he has to the greatest degree possible.

gadgets.name: Reserve Buoy
gadgets.description: Instantly fills the Super meter, but the next Torpedo Throw doesn't stun opponents.

gadgets.name: X-Ray-Shades
gadgets.description: Buzz can see into all bushes in his Super charging area for x seconds.

starPowers.name: Tougher Torpedo
starPowers.description: The minimum duration of Buzz's Super stun is increased by x seconds.

starPowers.name: Eyes Sharp
starPowers.description: Buzz's Super charging area is increased by x%.

brawlers.name: Grom
brawlers.description: Grom is a brawny security guard with one weak point: the flashbacks he gets from his time working at a kindergarten. Those kids were merciless.

gadgets.name: Watchtower
gadgets.description: Grom ejects a Watchtower from his Grom Bomb that gives all allies sight into bushes over a large area. The watchtower slowly loses health over time.

gadgets.name: Radio Check
gadgets.description: Grom's next attack throws x Buds in rapid succession.

starPowers.name: Foot Patrol
starPowers.description: When Grom's Super is fully charged, he gains +15% faster movement speed!

starPowers.name: X-Factor
starPowers.description: The split from Grom's main attack deals up to +x% extra damage at max distance.

brawlers.name: Squeak
brawlers.description: Squeak is a blob of happy energy who loves his creator, Ruffs. He's a joy to be around, at least if you are unaware that he's made of dog slobber

gadgets.name: Windup
gadgets.description: Squeak's next Sticky Blomb deals x% more damage and has x% longer range.

gadgets.name: Residue
gadgets.description: Squeak's next Sticky Blomb leaves a residue area behind after exploding, slowing down enemies and giving allies sight into bushes for x seconds.

starPowers.name: Chain Reaction
starPowers.description: Each opponent within the area of a Sticky Blomb's explosion increases the Blomb's damage by x%.

starPowers.name: Super Sticky
starPowers.description: Secondary Sticky Blomb explosions from Squeak's Super also slow down opponents for x seconds.

brawlers.name: Belle
brawlers.description: The leader of the notorious Goldarm Gang, Belle is after more than money. She wants to find out the truth behind Starr Park and bring it down!

gadgets.name: Nest Egg
gadgets.description: Belle places a trap on the ground that will explode when triggered by an opponent. The trap deals x damage, and slows down anyone within its blast radius for x seconds.

gadgets.name: Reverse Polarity
gadgets.description: Belle's next Electro-Bolt bounces from walls.

starPowers.name: Positive Feedback
starPowers.description: Belle gains a x% shield whenever her Electro-Bolts hit a target.

starPowers.name: Grounded
starPowers.description: Getting marked by Belle's Super prevents the opponent from reloading their attack for x seconds.

brawlers.name: Stu
brawlers.description: A little punch-drunk from too many bumps, bruises, and gasoline fumes over his long stunt performing career, Stu is a bit wobbly on his wheel these days.

gadgets.name: Speed Zone
gadgets.description: Stu drops a booster that makes himself, his teammates and other allies move faster while inside its area of effect.

gadgets.name: Breakthrough
gadgets.description: Stu's next Super can bash through obstacles, making debris fly forward. Each piece of debris deals x damage to any opponent it hits.

starPowers.name: Zero Drag
starPowers.description: Stu's Nitro Boost Super dash distance increases by x%.

starPowers.name: Gaso-Heal
starPowers.description: Using his Nitro Boost Super restores x of Stu's health.

brawlers.name: Ruffs
brawlers.description: Ruffs is a loyal, highly disciplined space colonel who runs a tight ship and does everything by the book. But deep down, he just wants to be a good boy!

gadgets.name: Take Cover
gadgets.description: Ruffs throws down x sandbags as cover. Each one has x% of Ruffs' max health.

gadgets.name: Air Support
gadgets.description: Ruffs calls a barrage around the nearest opponent, dealing x damage with each hit.

starPowers.name: Air Superiority
starPowers.description: Supply Drop now includes a bomb that adds x% more damage to the drop and also allows it to destroy walls.

starPowers.name: Field Promotion
starPowers.description: Friendly Brawlers have their maximum health increased by x every second that they are in range of this ability while it's active.

brawlers.name: Edgar
brawlers.description: Edgar believes nobody understands him. Certainly not his mom, who thinks he's going through a phase. Only he knows the darkness in his soul is eternal.

gadgets.name: Lets Fly
gadgets.description: Edgar's scarf grabs the closest Brawler and he jumps behind them. His scarf can also pull him towards walls.

gadgets.name: Hardcore
gadgets.description: Edgar gets a shield that protects him from the next x damage. The shield gets weaker over time.

starPowers.name: Hard Landing
starPowers.description: Edgar's Super and Let's Fly Gadget will also deal x damage to nearby enemies upon landing, or x damage on a direct hit.

starPowers.name: Fisticuffs
starPowers.description: Edgar receives 30% more healing from damage he deals.

buffies.name: Hardcore Buffie
buffies.description: Edgar also gains immunity to Crowd Control for 1 sec.

buffies.name: Hard Landing Buffie
buffies.description: A direct hit also charges his Super by 25%.

buffies.name: Fisticuffs Buffie
buffies.description: Taking down a Brawler instantly heals Edgar for 20% of his max health.

buffies.name: Hypercharge Buffie
buffies.description: Edgar's main attack has two extra scarf punches with longer range, but -50% damage.

brawlers.name: Byron
brawlers.description: Byron has invented many concoctions and tinctures that heal or harm in various ways.... but most of them fall into the harming category

gadgets.name: Shot In The Arm
gadgets.description: Byron uses one of his shots to heal himself x per second for x seconds.

gadgets.name: Booster Shots
gadgets.description: Byron's next attack shoots x darts instead of one, each dealing x% less damage and x% less healing.

starPowers.name: Malaise
starPowers.description: Byron's Super will also cause opponents to receive x% less healing from any source for x seconds.

starPowers.name: Injection
starPowers.description: Every x seconds the next basic attack will pierce through targets.

brawlers.name: Lou
brawlers.description: Lou is a robot snow cone salesman who's yet to make his first sale. Being located on a snowy mountain peak might have something to do with that.

gadgets.name: Ice Block
gadgets.description: Lou shields himself with ice, becoming invulnerable for x seconds.

gadgets.name: Cryo Syrup
gadgets.description: Instantly adds x% freeze meter to opponents inside Lou's Super.

starPowers.name: Supercool
starPowers.description: Opponents standing on Lou's Super area get frozen x% faster.

starPowers.name: Hypothermia
starPowers.description: Opponents lose up to x% of their damage based on how frozen they are from Lou's attacks.

brawlers.name: Amber
brawlers.description: Amber brings the heat, literally! She's overconfident about her fire abilities despite being a bit of a klutz. With her, it's spectacle first, and safety last.

gadgets.name: Fire Starters
gadgets.description: Amber summons an Oil barrel with x health, spilling oil when destroyed.

gadgets.name: Dancing Flames
gadgets.description: Amber creates x orbiting flames around her for x seconds, dealing x damage on hit.

starPowers.name: Wild Flames
starPowers.description: Amber's Fire Fluid becomes sticky, attaching to Brawlers and leaving a trail of oil while they move.

starPowers.name: Scorchin Siphon
starPowers.description: Amber reloads x% of her fire-breathing when an enemy takes fire damage.

brawlers.name: Colette
brawlers.description: Colette has collected every single figurine, plushie, and toy of every single Brawler. Is she obsessed? Yes. But has she lost touch with reality? Also yes.

gadgets.name: Na-Ah
gadgets.description: Colette fires a projectile that charms a Brawler for x sec. Uses ammo.

gadgets.name: Gotcha
gadgets.description: Colette fires a projectile that heals for x% of damage dealt. Uses ammo and can be fired 3 times before cooldown.

starPowers.name: Push It
starPowers.description: All enemy Brawlers hit by Colette's charge are carried to the farthest point of the attack! At max distance, they are stunned for 0.2 sec.

starPowers.name: Mass Tax
starPowers.description: Colette takes x% less damage during her Super and gains 30% shield for 3 sec if she hits a Brawler.

buffies.name: Na-Ah Buffie
buffies.description: The projectile pierces environments and Brawlers.

buffies.name: Gotcha Buffie
buffies.description: Can overheal, creating a shield of 1000 maximum health.

buffies.name: Push It Buffie
buffies.description: Super dash speed is significantly faster.

buffies.name: Mass Tax Buffie
buffies.description: Colette steals 33% ammo of any Brawlers she hits.

buffies.name: Hypercharge Buffie
buffies.description: Colette follows up each main attack with a smaller second attack that deals less damage.

brawlers.name: Surge
brawlers.description: Surge is a souped-up soda fountain, always ready to get the party started! He's got the beats, the moves, and an endless supply of energy drinks.

gadgets.name: Power Surge
gadgets.description: Surge's power surges! Increase Super charge rate by 30% for 5 sec.

gadgets.name: Power Shield
gadgets.description: Within the next 2 seconds, Surge consumes 50% of the damage of the next incoming hit and uses the energy to reload x ammo.

starPowers.name: To The Max
starPowers.description: Surge's Main Attack now bounces off walls.

starPowers.name: Serve Ice Cold
starPowers.description: Surge always spawns with a full Super Charge.

buffies.name: Power Surge Buffie
buffies.description: Power Surge also grants 30% Reload Speed.

buffies.name: Power Shield Buffie
buffies.description: If Surge is hit during Power Shield, Gadget cooldown is decreased by 50%.

buffies.name: To The Max Buffie
buffies.description: When bouncing off a wall, Surge's Main Attack splits into 2 extra projectiles.

buffies.name: Serve Ice Cold Buffie
buffies.description: While in Stage 3, Surge gains a burst of movement speed when using his Super.

buffies.name: Hypercharge Buffie
buffies.description: Surge shoots 'Double the Juice' for Double the Justice.

brawlers.name: Sprout
brawlers.description: Sprout appears to be a cute gardening robot who helps Rosa around the Biodome, but it's actually an incubator with arms and wheels for a strange pink seed!

gadgets.name: Garden Mulcher
gadgets.description: Sprout consumes a bush to restore x health.

gadgets.name: Transplant
gadgets.description: Sprout destroys its current Hedge, but will instantly have its Super fully charged again.

starPowers.name: Overgrowth
starPowers.description: Every x seconds, the next Seed Bomb will explode with a larger explosion radius.

starPowers.name: Photosynthesis
starPowers.description: Sprout activates a shield, partially protecting itself from all attacks while inside a bush.

brawlers.name: Nani
brawlers.description: Originally a security camera, Nani was modified to keep an eye on Jessie. Unfortunately, she can hardly keep up with the precocious girl!

gadgets.name: Warpin Time
gadgets.description: Nani teleports to Peep's last known location and ends her Super.

gadgets.name: Return To Sender
gadgets.description: For the next x seconds, the first time Nani takes damage from an enemy, x% of the damage is returned to the enemy.

starPowers.name: Autofocus
starPowers.description: Peep deals up to x extra damage based on his travel distance.

starPowers.name: Tempered Steel
starPowers.description: Nani takes x% less damage while her Super is active.

brawlers.name: Gale
brawlers.description: Gale's job is to use his snowblower to clear the areas around Mr. P's Snowtel. Nobody mentioned anything about stopping when the guests were around...

gadgets.name: Spring Ejector
